page.layout: One printed page. Top left: dedication title block (centred, in capitals and roman), with a greeting line below it. Below this: body text in one column, opening with a historiated woodcut initial at left. No margin notes. Top right: a library stamp and a handwritten shelf mark, both excluded.

main_text.l: Spartam nactus es, hac ornato. cuius origo,
ut opinio mea fert, ab ipsis Spartiatis
ciuibus nata est, sese inter se ad ciuitatis
tibus. Post uero ita celebrata haec
eadem uox est, ut ad quasuis honestas
tur, quam ego uocem cum ad me quoq;,
quem Deus in hoc iuris ciuilis interpre-

page.notes: The woodcut initial at the start of the text is a decorated letter whose shape resembles E; the word that follows reads "Vt", so the initial may be a V. Initial kept as "Vt" per the printed word. "cohortā-tibus": the tilde over the a and the line-end split are hard to read; the word may be cohortationibus or cohortatibus. Please check against the scan. "BED-fordiæ" line-end hyphen is slanted and may be a printed hyphen. Greeting line "Iurisc. s. P. D." is kept as a paragraph.
